tuning_details.interpretation: Project/target-specific configuration, not universal default. Primary comparison is matched checkout. Prior default first-build measurements are time-separated and also differ in TTL; they do not isolate a prefetch causal effect.

limitations: Shared archive/dependency and Bazel installation caches explicitly warm; source/output bases fresh; OS cache not dropped.
Logical blob bytes are not native Git transport bytes; encrypted Git transfer volume was not measured.
Persistent Git process lifetime spans phases; process-start counts are valid but nested wall sums are not additive critical-path time.
Git commit was not part of these timed matrices; separate native-commit compatibility and hydration evidence is required.

cleanup.basis: Existing successful shutdown commands and completed-cell records; completion follows mount teardown and unmounted check. Aggregation performs no new process or mount probes.

final_live_audit.correction: One disconnected tracing mount remained after its tracer/daemon exited. Normal untraced fusermount3 -u removed it; final live mountinfo/proc verification supersedes the earlier diagnostic teardown flag. Timed matrices unaffected.

paired_gate.policy: Proceed only with >=5% median paired query gain, all five pairs improving, and correctness/fetch/cleanup checks passing.
